record.body:
## Problem

When a phase finishes green, handoff and chat surface a summary. The machine proof (check-runs, diffs, aff trail/audit) exists but is not assembled into one place a human can look at. Demos help for UI work; most phases need other proof shapes (commands, claims, audit triage).

## Approach

Orchestra owns packaging: add project:proof-packet (not integration-report), handoff latest-proof, ## Proof on structured phases, and execute-phase assembly after the gate before done/merge. Require the packet write; do not require signed_by in v1. When .affidavit/manifest.json exists, pull aff trail/audit pointers into Machine/Attention. Decisions: proof-owner-orchestra, proof-packet-new-type, proof-gate-packet-not-signature.

## Exit criteria

1. Contract lists project:proof-packet with the agreed payload/kind/sections and handoff has latest-proof — verified by a check that loads the design / resolved contract.
2. settle-phase and plan-phase skill text require ## Proof (kind + look intent) for structured phases — verified by a skill grep/fixture test.
3. execute-phase skill assembles/creates/prints the packet after the gate, refuses done without a packet at revision, and documents aff trail/audit hooks — verified by skill tests.
4. Smoke: a proof-packet record at a real SHA has a usable Look section and appears under handoff latest-proof — verified by an integration check through adaptive-artifacts CLI.

## Proof

kind: claims
Looking means: open the proof-packet Look section (and Machine ids) for this phase at the phase-head SHA; re-run listed check commands if needed. Diff stat is secondary.

## Landing

branch: phase/phase-proof-packet
worktree: /home/andrewyin/orchestra/.worktrees/phase-proof-packet
base: main
close actions: commit code on the phase branch; merge that branch into main; commit the store on the primary checkout. Push is not a human stop for this run.
